rules.fixture_source: HotSpawn Pick'ems public fixtures endpoint (discovery only)
rules.probability_source: external bookmakers and the EGamersWorld odds widget — never HotSpawn
rules.join_rule: both team names must match after normalisation/alias mapping and, when the source publishes a start time, it must be within 8h of the lobby start time
rules.freshness_rule: market quotes older than 6h and live (in-play) markets are excluded from the published probability
rules.consensus_rule: arithmetic mean of per-source proportional no-vig probabilities
rules.pick_rule: pick = higher published probability; an edge below 0.005 is published as a coin flip with no pick
rules.estimate_rule: p(a beats b) = 1 / (1 + 10 ** (-(R_a - R_b) / 400)) on official Valve CS2 Regional Standings points. The 400-point scale is a stated modelling assumption, not a Valve-published quantity. Published only for CS2 and always labelled as an estimate.
rules.hotspawn_pick_pct: never used as an input to any probability
